cues.text: Jack, I'm thinking of taking the kids to the seaside on a surfing holiday this summer and I wanted to ask your advice - as I know you're such an expert.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Well, I don't know about that, but yes, I've done a bit of surfing over the years.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I'd thoroughly recommend it.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I think it's the kind of holiday all the family can enjoy together.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: The thing about surfing is that it's great for all ages and all abilities.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: My youngest started when he was only three!
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Wow! But it's quite physically demanding, isn't it?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I've heard you need to be pretty fit.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes. You'll certainly learn more quickly and won't tire as easily.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Well - that should be OK for us.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: You've been surfing a few times in Ireland, haven't you?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes. There's some great surfing there, which people don't always realise.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: And which locations would you recommend? - there seem to be quite a few.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes, there are loads.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Last year we went to County Donegal.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: There are several great places to surf there.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: What about in County Clare?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I read that's also really good for surfing.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes, it is.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I've been there a few times.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Most people go to Lahinch.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: My kids love it there.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: The waves aren't too challenging and the town is very lively.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Are there good hotels there?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes - some very nice ones and there are also a few basic hostels and campsites.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: It's great if you need lessons as the surf schools are excellent.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Sounds good.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes and there's lots to see in the area - like those well-known cliffs - ... I've forgotten the name of them ...
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Oh don't worry - I can look them up.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I've also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing, but we had a really good time.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: That was a few years ago when the kids were younger.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: There's a good surf school at Carrowniskey beach.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: How do you spell that?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: C-A-double R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: ОK.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I put the kids into the surf camp they run during the summer for 10-16 year olds.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Oh right. How long was that for?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Three hours every day for a week.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: It was perfect - they were so tired out after that.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: I can imagine.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: One thing we did while the kids were surfing was to rent some kayaks to have a look around the bay which is nearby.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: It's really beautiful.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: Oh, I'd love to do that.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Now the only time I went to Ireland it rained practically every day.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Mmm yes - that can be a problem - but you can surf in the rain, you know.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: It doesn't have the same appeal, somehow.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Well, the weather's been fine the last couple of years when I've been there, but actually, it tends to rain more in August than in the spring or autumn.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: September's my favourite month because the water is warmer then.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: The only problem is that the kids are back to school then.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I know. But one good thing about Irish summers is that it doesn't get too hot.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: The average temperature is about 19 degrees and it usually doesn't go above 25 degrees.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: That sounds alright.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Now what about costs?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Surfing is a pretty cheap holiday really - the only cost is the hire of equipment.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: You can expect to pay a daily rate of about 30 euros for the hire of a wetsuit and board - but you can save about 40 euros if you hire by the week.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: That's not too bad.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: No. It's important to make sure you get good quality wetsuits - you'll all get too cold if you don't.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: And make sure you also get boots.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: They keep your feet warm and it's easier to surf with them on too.
cues.speaker: JACK

cues.text: OK. Well, thanks very much …
cues.speaker: WOMAN
